Mozilla PDF.js 6.5.438
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.5.438
https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.5.438.tgz
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/tree/v6.5.438/l10n

The PDF display library and worker use upstream legacy minified files under shorter filenames.
The viewer module and stylesheet use the matching upstream legacy build.
The images, fonts, CMaps and decoders are upstream assets.
The zh-CN and en-US Fluent files come from the source tree and use MPL-2.0.
